SELECT P.MERCHANT_ID, P.BASE_DATE, P.TX_SEQ,
P.MERCHANT_ORDER_ID,
P.PAY_PROVIDER, S.CARD_COMPANY, S.VAN_NAME,
P.AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_AMOUNT, S.AMOUNT AS SETTLEMENT_REQUEST_AMOUNT, S.FEE_AMOUNT, S.VAT_AMOUNT, S.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT,
P.PAY_STATUS, S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS,
CASE -- 정산 데이터 자체가 없음 WHEN S.MERCHANT_ID IS NULL THEN 'UNSETTLED' -- 승인인데 정산상태가 완료가 아님 WHEN P.PAY_STATUS = 'APPROVE' AND S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS != 'COMPLETE' THEN 'STATUS_MISMATCH' -- 승인인데 금액 다름 WHEN P.PAY_STATUS = 'APPROVE' AND P.AMOUNT != S.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT THEN 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH' -- 정상 ELSE 'MATCH' END AS RECONCILIATION_STATUS,
CASE -- 정산 데이터 자체가 없음 WHEN S.MERCHANT_ID IS NULL THEN '미정산' -- 승인인데 정산상태가 완료가 아님 WHEN P.PAY_STATUS = 'APPROVE' AND S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS != 'COMPLETE' THEN '상태불일치' -- 승인인데 금액 다름 WHEN P.PAY_STATUS = 'APPROVE' AND P.AMOUNT != S.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT THEN '금액불일치' -- 정상 ELSE '정산' END AS RECONCILIATION_STATUS_NAME,
S.SETTLEMENT_DATE,
P.CREATED_AT
FROM PAYMENT P
LEFT JOIN SETTLEMENT_CARD S ON S.MERCHANT_ID = P.MERCHANT_ID AND S.BASE_DATE = P.BASE_DATE AND S.TX_SEQ = P.TX_SEQ
WHERE 1=1
AND P.PAY_METHOD = 'CARD'
AND P.MERCHANT_ID = #{dto.merchantId}
AND P.BASE_DATE >= #{dto.baseDateFrom}
AND P.BASE_DATE <= #{dto.baseDateTo}
AND ( CASE
WHEN S.TX_SEQ IS NULL THEN 'UNSETTLED'
WHEN P.PAY_STATUS = 'APPROVE' AND S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS != 'COMPLETE' THEN 'STATUS_MISMATCH'
WHEN P.AMOUNT != S.AMOUNT THEN 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH'
ELSE 'MATCH'
END ) = #{dto.reconciliationStatus}
ORDER BY P.BASE_DATE DESC, P.TX_SEQ DESC
OFFSET #{dto.offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{dto.size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) CNT
FROM PAYMENT P
LEFT JOIN SETTLEMENT_CARD S ON S.MERCHANT_ID = P.MERCHANT_ID AND S.BASE_DATE = P.BASE_DATE AND S.TX_SEQ = P.TX_SEQ
WHERE 1=1
AND P.PAY_METHOD = 'CARD'
AND P.MERCHANT_ID = #{dto.merchantId}
AND P.BASE_DATE >= #{dto.baseDateFrom}
AND P.BASE_DATE <= #{dto.baseDateTo}
AND ( CASE
WHEN S.TX_SEQ IS NULL THEN 'UNSETTLED'
WHEN P.PAY_STATUS = 'APPROVE' AND S.SETTLEMENT_STATUS != 'COMPLETE' THEN 'STATUS_MISMATCH'
WHEN P.AMOUNT != S.AMOUNT THEN 'AMOUNT_MISMATCH'
ELSE 'MATCH'
END ) = #{dto.reconciliationStatus}
